candidates.title: Burqa-clad, e-rickshaw clue: How cops tracked down model Shraddha Dubey
candidates.excerpt: Nagpur police used an e-rickshaw clue to track and arrest Shraddha Dubey and her associates. They fled from Uttar Pradesh and were located after a 24-hour surveillance operation. The operation was assisted by local intelligence and CCTV footage analysis. Shraddha claimed her innocence in a video but is suspected of involvement in a murder case. Police are examining circumstances surrounding the death of Shiva Sharma after the arrests.

candidates.excerpt: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.
